name: Izanai
source:
I wonder when it began? The moment when I started feeling my death close -

The clock ticks down to the moment of my death. It's been 10 years since I stepped into "Hirasakamura", looking for an answer about my lost memories. I made good friends, and we had "unbreakable bonds" between us. A man called the "Izanai Princess" looks at me with hatred. People in the village feel nostalgia.

Now, the stopped clock will start moving once again...
translation:
究竟是从什么时候开始的？从我开始感觉死亡近在咫尺的那一刻——

时钟正朝着我的死亡时刻倒数。为了寻找失落记忆的答案，我踏入“平坂村”已经十年。我结识了要好的朋友，彼此之间有着“牢不可破的羁绊”。一名被称作“伊邪那岐公主”的男子怀着憎恨注视着我，村里的人们则感到怀念。

如今，停摆的时钟将再次转动…
